title: DEV-05.2 — Release hardening: pinned Contrib runtime, genuine Pentaho certification and release gates
body:
## Objective
Close release-readiness evidence gaps after merged DEV-05.0 PR #65 and DEV-05.1 PR #67, without rewriting their historical reports or deploying production.

Branch: `release/dev-05-2-hardening` (created from `main`).

## P0 — Pinned OpenTelemetry Contrib binary
- Locate the two existing explicitly skipped runtime tests and identify exact required binary/version/platform.
- Introduce a reproducible, checksummed, license-compliant artifact provisioning path (download from authoritative release source or supplied approved local artifact). Pin version and SHA-256; fail closed on mismatch; avoid unverified latest downloads.
- Make test setup portable for disposable Docker/CI, offline where appropriate, with clear absence diagnostics.
- Execute both formerly skipped tests using the actual pinned binary. If artifact cannot be obtained, keep both SKIPPED/BLOCKED, not PASS. Preserve test intent and assertions.
- Record artifact provenance, checksums, commands and results.

## P0 — Genuine Pentaho provider certification
- Build a certification matrix for approved genuine Pentaho/PDI runtime: Carte/Pan/Kitchen version and auth/TLS configuration, live job/transformation success/failure, timestamps, status/log parsing, wrapper boundary, RBAC and secrets.
- Inspect existing RT-LAB evidence and local Pentaho references when available; distinguish earlier local lab results from fresh DEV-05.2 certification.
- Run only against explicitly authorized genuine environments. Do not infer real certification from synthetic Carte fixture or assume access to local Pentaho.
- If no approved runtime/credentials are accessible, produce a reproducible certification runbook and mark BLOCKED, with exact missing prerequisites.

## P1 — Other genuine provider readiness
- Track cloud and Windows live certification separately. Kubernetes monitoring remains deferred unless scope is explicitly approved.
- Explicitly distinguish supported baseline, synthetic contract coverage, live provider certification, and deferred features.

## P1 — Release-wide acceptance gates
- Confirm all applicable required GitHub Actions checks on the current branch/PR.
- Validate auth/tenant boundaries, worker protocol, TLS/egress restrictions, secret redaction, audit, migrations, alert transitions, dashboard, recovery, rollback and backup/restore runbooks, observability, reproducible image provenance, SBOM/dependency/license/security scans, resource cleanup.
- Production control-plane TLS, load testing, external notification delivery, and operational DR remain NOT TESTED until approved environments and criteria exist.
- Define explicit GO / CONDITIONAL GO / NO-GO criteria; do not call any unrun test PASS.
- Preserve immutable original failure evidence in PR #65 and DEV-05.1 remediation evidence; create separate dated DEV-05.2 report with commit SHAs, commands, machine-readable outcomes, screenshots/logs where useful, skips and blockers.

## Acceptance and restrictions
- Separate draft PR against main with implementation, test changes, and new evidence; never modify original failed evidence.
- No production deployment, no real customer data, no unauthorized credentials/endpoints, no auto merge.
- No blanket Docker cleanup or unnecessary reruns of unrelated passing CI workflows.
- Do not weaken existing assertions or mark synthetic fixtures as genuine certification.
- Clearly identify each blocker and required owner-provided input before declaring release readiness.
- Include exact Contrib test names, genuine-provider evidence status, CI status, remaining release gate matrix and overall decision.
